title: Invoice export fails with a server error
summary: The CSV and PDF export of invoices returns a 500 while the billing renderer is under load. Exporting a single invoice works.
steps_md:
- Open the invoice you need from the **Invoices** table.
- Use **Download** on the individual invoice instead of **Export invoices**.
- For a full month, request the export again after a few minutes - the renderer retries automatically.
- If you need all invoices now, ask Billing support to email the monthly statement.

title: Invoice amounts show the wrong currency symbol
summary: Workspaces created before v2.2 display amounts with the default currency symbol rather than the workspace currency.
steps_md:
- Go to **Billing > Preferences**.
- Set **Display currency** explicitly, even if it already looks correct.
- Reload the Billing page.

title: Payment method cannot be removed while an invoice is open
summary: Removing the saved card is blocked until every open invoice is settled.
steps_md:
- Settle or cancel any invoice still marked **Open**.
- Return to **Settings > Payment** and remove the card.

title: "Permission denied" when inviting a teammate
summary: Inviting people requires the Admin role. A Member account gets a bare "Permission denied" message with no explanation.
steps_md:
- Check your role under the avatar menu - invites need **Admin**.
- Ask a workspace admin to send the invite, or to raise your role.
- Admins can invite from **Projects > Team > Invite teammate**.

title: Archived projects still appear in the project list
summary: The project list caches for up to ten minutes, so a freshly archived project can linger.
steps_md:
- Reload the page with a hard refresh.
- If it is still listed after ten minutes, open the project and confirm its status is **Archived**.

title: Project members cannot see shared files
summary: Files uploaded before a member joined stay restricted to the original uploader unless the project is set to share history.
steps_md:
- Open **Projects > Settings > Sharing**.
- Turn on **Share file history with new members**.
- New members then see files uploaded before they joined.

title: Analytics export is capped at 1,000 rows
summary: CSV exports from Analytics stop at 1,000 rows. Larger exports need the scheduled report.
steps_md:
- Narrow the date range so the result is under 1,000 rows, or
- Use **Analytics > Scheduled reports** to have the full export emailed.

title: Charts render empty in Safari 15
summary: Analytics charts are blank on Safari 15 and older because of an unsupported canvas API.
steps_md:
- Update Safari to version 16 or later.
- As a stopgap, open Analytics in Chrome or Firefox.

title: Timezone in Analytics does not match the workspace setting
summary: Analytics buckets events in UTC until a workspace timezone is saved explicitly.
steps_md:
- Open **Settings > Workspace > Timezone**.
- Save the timezone even if the correct one is already shown.
- Reload Analytics - buckets realign within a minute.

title: Two-factor codes are rejected right after setup
summary: Codes fail for a few minutes after enabling two-factor authentication while the device clock syncs.
steps_md:
- Check that your phone's clock is set automatically.
- Wait for the next code and try again.
- Use a recovery code if you are locked out.
